posts.text:
3 years ago I wrote this piece for @theatlantic.com about why we mustn’t take public health for granted.

This is long before this admin’s deep cuts to public health.

With the massive Cyclospora outbreak, I couldn’t help thinking about my own warning from the past.
posts.summary: Warns against neglecting public health infrastructure and preparedness

What impact will AI have on that skill?
